snippet.title: Clay Jam - Out Now!
snippet.description:
Save the land of Clay Jam from the fearsome Bully Beasts. Guide Fat Pebble as he rolls down five weird and wonderful hills in a world made entirely from clay!
Squash monsters on the way, and he'll grow and grow and GROW! Get all the way to the bottom of the hill and meet the nasty Bully Beasts.

Can you collect enough clay to free the monsters and save Clay Jam?!

Features:
● EVERYTHING in the game is made from real clay!
● Family-friendly - no in-app purchases or ads, plus offline play
● Squash, roll and bounce your way through a very peculiar world
● A unique control system - gouge paths in the clay to steer
● Loads of hand-made monsters to discover
● 5 amazingly strange hills to rebuild
● 5 fearsome Bully Beasts to defeat
● Brilliantly original music
● Fantastically funny sound effects

***************
Editor's Choice in over 100 countries
#1 Kids game in 46 countries
#1 Action game in 10 countries
Nominated for a BAFTA!
Nominated for the Pocket Gamer awards!
Over 10 million downloads!
***************

USA Today
“Clay Jam is a blast to play for kids and kids at heart, so be sure to roll over to the App Store to download the game.”

Pocket Gamer
Full of character and colour, Clay Jam is easy to pick up and very hard to put down.
It's also one of the most refreshing freemium games around, rewarding you for continual play rather than punishing you for not spending money.

Modojo
An incredible artistic and technical achievement with very satisfying gameplay and progression.

Kotaku
... every lovingly-molded inch of Clay Jam is an uncanny delight.

Gametrailers - App of the Day
Clay Jam is a very rare treat on the App Store. It's refreshingly different from the rest of the pack, plays like a dream, and is balanced so perfectly that both kids and adults alike will get a suitable level of challenge from the game. Download this immediately.

Gamezebo
... Clay Jam is an extremely satisfying experience shaped from mounds of sheer joy.
